references.text: The description of the gold altar (the incense altar) built according to God's command, including its carrying poles and function in the tabernacle.
Bezalel made the gold altar with its carrying poles from acacia wood, overlaid with gold, so that it could be carried during transport.
Instructions about carrying poles to be used for transporting holy objects, a consistent principle for moving the tabernacle's equipment.
The same pattern for covering holy objects with blue cloth and tachash skins when the camp was to break camp.
Tachash skins are mentioned as the covering material for the tabernacle, the same material used to cover the gold altar during transport.
Hebrews mentions the golden altar of incense as part of the holy furnishings of the tabernacle.
